nodes.guidance:
Definition: This field uniquely identifies the sending application among all other applications within the network enterprise. The network enterprise consists of all those applications that participate in the exchange of HL7 messages within the enterprise. Entirely site-defined.
· Element “Namespace ID” SHALL NOT be present
· Element “Universal ID” SHALL be set to the National Organization OID issued.
· Element “Universal ID Type” SHALL be set to “ISO”
Format of the National Organization OID:
2.16.840.1.113883.3.3731.XXXX
The National Organization OID is composed like in the format above, where XXXX is the nphies assigned OID extension that includes the organization identifier value out of the KSA-Wide Healthcare Provider Directory.
Example: |^2.16.840.1.113883.3.3731.5.1.15000000112233^ISO|
